message:
Read-only C0 original-Git verification completed. `git remote get-url origin` = https://github.com/Serdan/Jarvis.git. Local main, origin/main and `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main` all agree at 95a471fc565b57fe309c65fc85f371693dbe9067 (parent bea5f40867720e909746c0d0cade1ca68e86f7f4; tree 97946d6071ca79ac8dbd93803e1774d89e8ef83f); working tree clean. `refs/heads/jarvis-orchestration` is remotely advertised at b0d4407144c3675df84d33f2c0a25636fc2b82e5 (parent 1a4f09255c79e6aedb495a93ee267186a23f752c; tree ce5bb12b50c2322fada2c278a831887f7928c14f). Frozen C0 review ref exists remotely at 17277a51dcec0f481db9870019e2ba6295b3b739 (parent a83549a6897a4e26aa4834ff81dc38b6e16ee85e; tree a647dda36d651e72b713119a4502d8b66be1926d). `git cat-file -t` confirmed these inspected OIDs are commits. Main and Worker23's registered worktree share the same local `.git` common directory; that proves local worktree sharing only, not production publisher sharing. The registered client inventory exposes the Jarvis project on one client; the second exposes Jarvis-Windows-QA, not Jarvis.

Source evidence: `Client/Modules/LedgerStore.fs:1131,1217-1218` pushes locally created commits directly to the protected ledger ref (object delivery and ref mutation coupled); `:649-710` fetches only the already-published ledger ref; `:1606-1631` identifies the local registered worktree and configured fetch/push URLs, not an independent publisher's object visibility. `AccountCapacityLedger.fs:692-695` likewise pushes its local commit to the account ref. `Server/OriginalGitPublisherAdmission.fs:16-39` carries a proposed OID but no object manifest/transfer handle. `Server/OriginalGitPublisherExecutor.fs:8-28,127-180` is an internal fixture remote. `Server/WorkLegacySourceWitness.fs:10-13,61-87` explicitly says no production authenticated reader is registered and no Scheduler/API calls it; a Server-wide search found no concrete reader registration. The bare-Git test stages objects only via test-only `refs/heads/publisher-stage` before `update-ref`.

Conclusion: ordinary authenticated Git access and local worktree object sharing are verified; no authenticated production publisher-side object read/transfer path or physical publisher object-store sharing is evidenced. No live unpublished producer candidate with publisher-side commit/tree/parent proof was identified. No push/fetch mutation, ref change, source edit or deployment was performed. C0 remains HOLD; Worker16 remains Parked/Blocked. Do not resume or invent positive fixture authority. The next valid input is new authorized publisher-side read evidence or a separately reviewed default-off non-ref-mutating object-delivery lease. Live quarantine push, credentials/grants, publisher release, STOP and protected-ref update remain separate Operator decisions. This hold does not block Worker6's independent Release proof or the Jarvis Scheduler/Challenges frontier.
